critical_code_review_comments: server.py:529 GET /patients/{pid}/portal correctly performs lazy token generation via secrets.token_urlsafe(9) then $set-persist; second call reads existing token — idempotent as advertised.

server.py:766 public_patient_portal is defined WITHOUT Depends(get_current_user) and computes financials as sum(total)/sum(paid)/diff on patient-kind invoices only — matches spec. Correctly restricted to `kind=='patient'` so business expenses are not leaked.
server.py:515 create_patient injects portal_token at creation; server.py:865 public_book also injects portal_token on newly-created booking patients — both paths verified via tests.
frontend/src/portal-share.ts uses proper phone sanitization (/[^\d]/g) and falls back to wa.me/?text= when no phone — safe; graceful degradation.
frontend/app/_layout.tsx:31 AuthGate allowlist `segments[0] === 'book' || segments[0] === 'p'` correctly exposes /p/[token] as public; verified in browser (no login redirect).
frontend/app/p/[token].tsx keeps rendering purely from `api.publicPatientPortal(token)` response; error path sets notFound=true — proper loading/error/success states.
frontend/app/patient/billing/[id].tsx: FAB testID='billing-add' opens invoice modal reusing invoices CRUD (kind=patient, patient_id set) — no new backend endpoint required.
(Nit) server.py currency default is SYP and invoice model preserves USD — regression covered.
